tools.name: aml-monitoring_ctr-aggregate
tools.description: Aggregate cash-in and cash-out per person per US business day and list totals that trigger a Currency Transaction Report. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/aml-monitoring/ctr-aggregate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: aml-monitoring_structuring-detect
tools.description: Flag repeated just-below-threshold cash deposits as a structuring heuristic for analyst review. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/aml-monitoring/structuring-detect. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: aml-monitoring_rapid-movement-detect
tools.description: Detect credits quickly followed by similar-sized debits as a money-mule pass-through indicator on caller data. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/aml-monitoring/rapid-movement-detect. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: aml-monitoring_sar-deadline
tools.description: Compute US bank SAR filing deadlines or UK POCA s.335 notice and moratorium periods from vendored holiday calendars. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/aml-monitoring/sar-deadline. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "aml-monitoring" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: aml-monitoring_ctr-aggregate · Public sink: aml-monitoring_ctr-aggregate, aml-monitoring_structuring-detect, aml-monitoring_rapid-movement-detect, aml-monitoring_sar-deadline · Destructive: aml-monitoring_ctr-aggregate, aml-monitoring_structuring-detect, aml-monitoring_rapid-movement-detect, aml-monitoring_sar-deadline.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: aml-monitoring_ctr-aggregate · Public sink: aml-monitoring_ctr-aggregate, aml-monitoring_structuring-detect, aml-monitoring_rapid-movement-detect, aml-monitoring_sar-deadline · Destructive: aml-monitoring_ctr-aggregate, aml-monitoring_structuring-detect, aml-monitoring_rapid-movement-detect, aml-monitoring_sar-deadline

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
